props.name: children
props.description: Text, SVG or icon to extrude. It should draw with currentColor.

props.name: layers
props.description: Number of stacked copies. More is smoother.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the front face. Any CSS colour.

props.name: sideColor
props.description: Colour at the back of the extrusion.

props.name: sway
props.description: Maximum idle sway in degrees. 0 disables.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
